defect_log.title: Leading '+' in E.164 phone numbers misparsed by CSV/spreadsheet readers
defect_log.root_cause: International numbers formatted as '+91-98104-52391' were occasionally treated as numeric expressions or stripped of '+' when loaded without explicit string dtype enforcement.
defect_log.fix_applied: Enforced dtype={'phone_number': str} in pd.read_csv() and added sanitize_phone_number() to strip leading apostrophes and normalize E.164 formatting across all inputs.

defect_log.title: Potential preprocessing data leakage if Scaler/Imputer fit before train-test split
defect_log.root_cause: Fitting StandardScaler and SimpleImputer on the full 6,000-row dataset prior to splitting leaks test-set distribution statistics into training.
defect_log.fix_applied: Refactored prepare_train_test_splits() to perform the 80/20 stratified split first and call preprocessor.fit(X_train) strictly on the training partition.

defect_log.title: Zero-division error when calculating community risk score for numbers with 0 reports
defect_log.root_cause: Unseen phone numbers had total_reports = 0 in SQLite, causing division by zero when computing weighted report ratios.
defect_log.fix_applied: Added max(total_reports, 1) guard and implemented prefix-aware heuristic baseline scoring for first-seen phone numbers.

defect_log.title: Overlapping regex matches corrupting inline HTML highlight tags
defect_log.root_cause: When two scam regex patterns matched overlapping substrings (e.g., '6-digit OTP' and 'OTP verification code'), nested highlight spans broke markup rendering.
defect_log.fix_applied: Added span sorting by (start, -length) and non-overlapping interval merging before rendering highlights.
